_note: Ground truth for Laws-of-the-Game questions uses IFAB's stable Law 1-17 numbering, which has not changed edition to edition. Ground truth for the two 'supplementary_pending' questions cannot be finalized until the FIFA Disciplinary Code and VAR protocol PDFs are supplied and ingested -- they are excluded from headline metrics until then. See README eval section.

questions.question: How many players are on each team on the field at the start of a match?
What is the official length and width range of a football pitch?
What is the required circumference of the match ball?
How long is a standard match before extra time, in minutes?
From what distance is a penalty kick taken?

How must a throw-in be performed for it to be legal?
How is play restarted when the ball goes out over the goal line, last touched by an attacker, and no goal is scored?
From where is a corner kick taken?
If the ball accidentally strikes a player's arm while the arm is close to the body in a natural position, is that a handball offense?
questions.notes: Tests nuanced handball interpretation, not just the existence of the rule.

questions.question: Is a player in an offside position automatically penalized just for standing there?
questions.notes: Tests the active-involvement nuance of offside.

questions.question: Does the goalkeeper count as the last defender for offside purposes if they have advanced out of the penalty area?

questions.notes: VAR only intervenes on clear/obvious errors in specific categories -- tests whether retrieval finds VAR-authority content.

questions.question: Is denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by handball always punished with a straight red card?

questions.question: Can a team be awarded an indirect free kick for a dangerous play that doesn't involve any physical contact?
